name: fedora-kde
description: Administer, diagnose, and customize Fedora KDE using local evidence, compatibility checks, and verified changes.

interface.longDescription: Diagnose, administer, secure, tune, and customize Fedora KDE. Inspect the local environment when needed, verify compatibility, and validate changes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Handle my Fedora KDE request: inspect only the necessary local context, verify compatibility, and apply the smallest change with validation and rollback. Respond in English unless I request another language.
